guest_pay.note: Use Make a Payment on TAP to pay without logging in.

autopay.note: TAP has no recurring automatic payments for an income tax balance. Once a payment agreement is set up, you can contact Collections to have its payments debited automatically.

payment_arrangement.note: A payment agreement can be requested only after your return is processed and the balance is set. Penalty and interest keep accruing.

pay_by_phone.note: If you cannot pay online, call 801-297-7703 (800-662-4335 ext. 7703) to pay by phone.

help.title: Payment options and fees
paragraphs: Pay on TAP with a Standard Payment from a bank account (free) or by credit or debit card, which carries a 3% convenience fee through GovPay. The first payment from new bank information may take up to 10 days because of prenote verification.

TAP also offers Coupon Payment for a letter with a coupon code and Multi-Source Payment to debit several bank accounts at once. When you file an individual income tax return on TAP, you can also pay with cryptocurrency through a PayPal personal account, which carries service fees. If you cannot pay online, call 801-297-7703 to pay by phone.
To pay by mail, make the check payable to the Utah State Tax Commission and send it to 210 N 1950 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84134.

help.title: Payment agreements
paragraphs: Request a payment agreement on TAP, by phone at 801-297-7703, or with Form TC-804. An agreement can be set up only after your return is processed and the balance is known. Agreements are a service, not a right, and all agreement notices are sent by email.

On an agreement of less than 25 months that is paid on time, a lien is generally not recorded. Penalty and interest keep accruing. Once set up, you can contact Collections to have payments debited automatically.
Defaulting, adding new debt or not filing and paying returns on time can lead to a lien, garnishment of wages and bank accounts, and seizure of property, and refunds may be applied to the debt.
